reviews.reading_evidence: Read all six complete source/target stanzas,78lines, including two-line nine-creature list: composite god stitched/not needle-thread but ephemeral imaginative fusion/physical metaphysical universe; rooster lion snake peacock elephant bull deer horse human; same vastness as speaker long ago/poetic paradox ink/Sarala subtle sight/forest fragrance/story mouth, artists limbs/fingers/flower creation/patachitra moving story/nine-bodied dancer/proud polymorph neither human animal nor both; celestial or earthborn dark vision/ear and heart lowered asking what; bow put down, imagination not exclusive/other seeds fruit, need not discard unbelieved or own world in knowledge/need not know each other to surrender to truth/multiple not monstrous/one in many/self meeting ego melts before vulnerability, rooster plume/tiger claw/snake tail awakened hurt or none/self-other unknowable; final injunction not aim arrow of subjugation, human-form god diminishes oceanic possibilities, difference within/with self, bow lowered. Checked negative modal force, ephemeral versus subtle and haunting as lingering effect rather than physical pursuit; retained lion-to-tiger shift.
reviews.reason: Restore transience of ephemeral and haunting as a lingering mental effect, not a fragrance or image literally following someone.
open_questions: Prior Sarala/Nabagunjara allusions not supplemented with lore; initial lion and later tiger both source-backed. Mind-tongues/corporeality/metaphysicality/vulnerability-fire and pronoun shifts require specialist review.

Ephemeral is translated as transitory as written; if ethereal was intended, only source/editor confirmation may establish it. Same-vastness as-I-have-done syntax remains difficult; no invented origin story.
reviews.tradeoff: Dedicated long-poem batch preserves all78lines, six stanzas, source contradictions, philosophical ambiguity and bow refrain. Same-assistant self-review, independent review pending.

prior_uncertainties.note: All six stanzas and 78 lines retained, including two-line nine-creature list. Source lists lion initially but tiger claw later; both retained. Sarala and Nabagunjara references not supplemented with invented lore. Mind-tongues, corporeality/metaphysicality and vulnerability-fire remain difficult expressions for specialist review.
